segments.name: Power solution products
segments.description: Manufactures and sells power solution products, such as inverters and generators, used in vehicles, appliances and outdoor living.
segments.evidence: Management, including the chief operating decision maker, reviews operation results as one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers, mainly international companies and retail channels, pay for power solution products built to order.
revenueModel.evidence: Furthermore, we are a supplier for many international companies, including Einhell Germany AG, Canadian Tire Corporation Limited, Steren Electronics International, LLC, etc.
